title: De Firato (Polygoon, Weeknummer 65-39) / The Firato electronics fair
license: CC-BY-SA 3.0 NL (Open Beelden / Beeld en Geluid; Polygoon-Profilti producent)
notes: Netherlands, Dutch: Polygoon-Profilti newsreel, RAI Amsterdam 1965, commentary Philip Bloemendal — the Firato electronics fair: transistor-radio stands, flat televisions, then the long window: children at a record player that drives a slide screen, a video camera, 'weergave via videorecorder', a reel-to-reel VTR playing the picture back on a set; a 'Het Elektron' lecture, an army armoured car full of electronics, a car tape recorder, and a man playing an electric guitar that makes organ sounds. Source MPG rendition from openbeelden.nl, uncropped.
